   161	  function _nonEmptyStr(v) { return typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0; }
   162	  function _isFiniteNumber(v) { return typeof v === 'number' && _CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_FINITE(v) === true; }
   163	  function _isOriginalPlainObject(v) {
   164	    try {
   165	      if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object' || _CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(v)) return false;
   166	      var p = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_PROTO(v);
   167	      return p === Object.prototype || p === null;
   168	    } catch (e) { return false; }
   169	  }
   170	  function _idGrammarOk(s) {
   171	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;
   172	    if (ID_FORBIDDEN_RE.test(s)) return false;
   173	    if (!ID_GRAMMAR_RE.test(s)) return false;
   174	    return true;
   175	  }
   176	  function _i18nKeyOk(s) {
   177	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;
   178	    if (s.length > I18N_KEY_MAX_LEN) return false;
   179	    if (!I18N_KEY_RE.test(s)) return false;
   180	    return true;
   181	  }
   182	  function _hasSymbolOwnKey(o) {
   183	    try {
   184	      var syms = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_SYMS(o);
   185	      return _CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(syms) && syms.length > 0;
   186	    } catch (e) { return true; }
   187	  }
   188	  function _snapshotPlain(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode) {
   189	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(o)) return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED], detail: 'not plain' };
   190	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(o)) return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key' };
   191	    var names;
   192	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(o); }
   193	    catch (e) { return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'desc fail' }; }
   194	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   195	    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
   196	      var k = names[i];
   197	      if (_arrIndexOf(allowedKeys, k) === -1) {
   198	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'unknown key ' + k };
   199	      }
   200	      var d;
   201	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(o, k); }
   202	      catch (e) { return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'desc inaccessible' }; }
   203	      if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enum ' + k };
   204	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   205	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor ' + k };
   206	      }
   207	      snap[k] = d.value;
   208	    }
   209	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   210	  }
   211	  function _deepFreeze(v) {
   212	    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
   213	    try { _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(v); } catch (e) { /* swallow */ }
   214	    var keys;
   215	    try { keys = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (e) { return v; }
   216	    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
   217	      var child;
   218	      try { child = v[keys[i]]; } catch (e) { continue; }
   219	      _deepFreeze(child);
   220	    }
   221	    return v;
   222	  }

   224	  // ---------- Deterministic ID generators ----------------------------------------------------
   225	  function _hash32(s) {
   226	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   227	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   228	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   229	      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
   230	      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
   231	    }
   232	    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
   233	  }
   234	  function _fnv2(s) {
   235	    var slen = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   236	    return _hash32(s) + _hash32(s + '|' + slen);
   237	  }

   279	  function _resolveClock(optsIn) {
   280	    var snap;
   281	    if (optsIn === undefined || optsIn === null) snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   282	    else {
   283	      var r = _snapshotPlain(optsIn, OPTS_KEYS, CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID);
   284	      if (r.valid !== true) return { valid: false, reasonCodes: r.reasonCodes, detail: r.detail };
   285	      snap = r.snapshot;
   286	      if (snap.clock !== undefined && snap.clock !== null && typeof snap.clock !== 'function') {
   287	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], detail: 'opts.clock not function' };
   288	      }
   289	      if (snap.referenceNowMs !== undefined && snap.referenceNowMs !== null
   290	          && (typeof snap.referenceNowMs !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(snap.referenceNowMs) || snap.referenceNowMs < 0)) {
   291	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], detail: 'opts.referenceNowMs invalid' };
   292	      }
   293	    }
   294	    var refMs = null;
   295	    var iso = null;
   296	    if (typeof snap.referenceNowMs === 'number') {
   297	      refMs = snap.referenceNowMs;
   298	      // Codex E4-R2-01 closure: canonicalization via captured intrinsics with round-trip
   299	      // verification. Post-load Date / Date.prototype.toISOString mutation cannot affect.
   300	      iso = _canonicalIso(refMs);
   301	    } else if (typeof snap.clock === 'function') {
   302	      var ciso = null;
   303	      try { ciso = snap.clock(); } catch (e) { ciso = null; }
   304	      if (typeof ciso === 'string' && ciso.length > 0) {
   305	        var ms = _isoToMs(ciso);
   306	        if (typeof ms === 'number') {
   307	          refMs = ms;
   308	          iso = _canonicalIso(ms);
   309	        }
   310	      }
   311	    }
   312	    if (typeof refMs !== 'number' || refMs !== refMs || iso === null) {
   313	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], detail: 'cannot resolve clock' };
   314	    }
   315	    return { valid: true, refMs: refMs, iso: iso };
   316	  }

   318	  // ---------- E4 timeline-event params validator (shared by append + project) ---------------
   319	  // Codex E4-R1-01 closure: projectTimeline MUST re-apply the SAME primitive allowlist
   320	  // used by appendTimelineEvent. The E1 contract is structurally permissive (params
   321	  // accepts any plain object); the E4 service layer adds the strict allowlist. A
   322	  // corrupted stored event with hostile params must NOT survive into an authoritative
   323	  // projection.
   324	  function _validateEventParams(params) {
   325	    if (params === null || params === undefined) return { valid: true, value: null };
   326	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(params)) return { valid: false, code: 'params not plain' };
   327	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(params)) return { valid: false, code: 'params has Symbol key' };
   328	    var names;
   329	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(params); }
   330	    catch (e) { return { valid: false, code: 'params desc fail' }; }
   331	    if (names.length > 16) return { valid: false, code: 'params keys exceed cap' };
   332	    var rebuilt = {};
   333	    for (var pi = 0; pi < names.length; pi++) {
   334	      var pk = names[pi];
   335	      // 'correction_of' is the canonical reserved key — its value is a strict id.
   336	      var keyOk = /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$/.test(pk);
   337	      if (!keyOk) return { valid: false, code: 'params key not sober: ' + pk };
   338	      // Codex E4-R2-03 closure: even sober ids that match reserved hostile tokens (blame,
   339	      // cause, driver_error, ...) are forbidden in BOTH keys and string values. Narrative
   340	      // / causal / blame content must travel through i18n keys whose translations live
   341	      // outside the runtime — never as bare strings in the event params.
   342	      if (_containsReservedHostileToken(pk)) return { valid: false, code: 'params key matches reserved hostile token: ' + pk };
   343	      var pd;
   344	      try { pd = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(params, pk); }
   345	      catch (e) { return { valid: false, code: 'params desc fail at ' + pk }; }
   346	      if (!pd || pd.enumerable !== true) return { valid: false, code: 'params non-enum at ' + pk };
   347	      if (typeof pd.get === 'function' || typeof pd.set === 'function') {
   348	        return { valid: false, code: 'params accessor at ' + pk };
   349	      }
   350	      var pv = pd.value;
   351	      if (pv === null) {
   352	        // allowed
   353	      } else if (typeof pv === 'boolean') {
   354	        // allowed
   355	      } else if (typeof pv === 'number') {
   356	        if (!_isFiniteNumber(pv)) return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] not finite' };
   357	      } else if (typeof pv === 'string') {
   358	        if (!_i18nKeyOk(pv) && !_idGrammarOk(pv)) {
   359	          return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] string not strict i18n key / id' };
   360	        }
   361	        // Codex E4-R2-03 closure: reserved hostile tokens in string values are forbidden
   362	        // regardless of grammar match.
   363	        if (_containsReservedHostileToken(pv)) {
   364	          return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] string matches reserved hostile token' };
   365	        }
   366	      } else {
   367	        return { valid: false, code: 'params[' + pk + '] not primitive (string/number/boolean/null)' };
   368	      }
   369	      try {
   370	        _CAPTURED_OBJECT_DEFINE_PROPERTY(rebuilt, pk, { value: pv, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true });
   371	      } catch (e) {
   372	        return { valid: false, code: 'params rebuild failed at ' + pk };
   373	      }
   374	      // Codex E4-R1-03 / E3-R4-01 closure pattern: re-read descriptor and verify value
   375	      // identity with Object.is. Defeats pre-load defineProperty poisoning.
   376	      var dCheck;
   377	      try { dCheck = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(rebuilt, pk); }
   378	      catch (e) { return { valid: false, code: 'params re-read fail' }; }
   379	      if (!dCheck || dCheck.enumerable !== true || typeof dCheck.get === 'function' || typeof dCheck.set === 'function') {
   380	        return { valid: false, code: 'params post-define corrupt at ' + pk };
   381	      }
   382	      var same = false;
   383	      try { same = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS(dCheck.value, pv) === true; } catch (e) { same = false; }
   384	      if (!same) return { valid: false, code: 'params post-define value mismatch at ' + pk };
   385	    }
   386	    return { valid: true, value: rebuilt };
   387	  }

   410	    // ---- createFollowUpLink --------------------------------------------------------------
   411	    function createFollowUpLink(inputIn, optsIn) {
   412	      // Step 1: descriptor snapshot (closed key set, no Symbol / accessor / Proxy).
   413	      var inR = _snapshotPlain(inputIn, LINK_INPUT_KEYS, CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID);
   414	      if (inR.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block(inR.reasonCodes, inR.detail));
   415	      var i = inR.snapshot;
   416	
   417	      // Step 2: structural validation
   418	      if (!_idGrammarOk(i.parentCaseId)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.LINKAGE_PARENT_MISSING], 'parentCaseId invalid'));
   419	      if (!_idGrammarOk(i.followUpCaseId)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], 'followUpCaseId invalid'));
   420	      if (i.parentCaseId === i.followUpCaseId) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], 'self-link forbidden'));
   421	      if (!_idGrammarOk(i.experimentId)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], 'experimentId invalid'));
   422	      var parentStatus = i.parentStatus === undefined ? 'present' : i.parentStatus;
   423	      if (FU.PARENT_STATUS_ALLOWED && _arrIndexOf(FU.PARENT_STATUS_ALLOWED, parentStatus) === -1) {
   424	        return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], 'parentStatus invalid'));
   425	      }
   426	
   427	      // Step 3: opts + clock (post-authority)
   428	      var ck = _resolveClock(optsIn);
   429	      if (ck.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block(ck.reasonCodes, ck.detail));
   430	
   431	      // Step 4: build link record
   432	      var link = {
   433	        schemaVersion: LINK_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   434	        linkId: _linkId(i.parentCaseId, i.followUpCaseId, i.experimentId),
   435	        parentCaseId: i.parentCaseId,
   436	        followUpCaseId: i.followUpCaseId,
   437	        experimentId: i.experimentId,
   438	        parentStatus: parentStatus,
   439	        createdAt: ck.iso,
   440	      };
   441	
   442	      // Step 5: validate via E1 contract
   443	      var vCheck = FU.validateFollowUpLinkShape(link);
   444	      if (vCheck.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block(vCheck.reasonCodes ? _arrSlice(vCheck.reasonCodes) : [CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], 'shape invalid'));
   445	
   446	      // Step 6: persist via E2 store + register authority
   447	      return followUpLinkStore.create(link).then(function () {
   448	        _deepFreeze(link);
   449	        _registerAuthoritativeLink(link);
   450	        return _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE({ valid: true, link: link });
   451	      }, function (err) {
   452	        // Surface the E2 error code as a structured BLOCK.
   453	        return _block([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], (err && err.code) ? String(err.code) : 'link store failure');
   454	      });
   455	    }

   463	        // is owned by the service, then registered.
   464	        var r = _snapshotPlain(rec, _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(['schemaVersion', 'linkId', 'parentCaseId', 'followUpCaseId', 'experimentId', 'parentStatus', 'createdAt']), CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID);
   465	        if (r.valid !== true) return null;

   517	    // ---- appendTimelineEvent ------------------------------------------------------------
   518	    function appendTimelineEvent(inputIn, optsIn) {
   519	      // Step 1: descriptor snapshot
   520	      var inR = _snapshotPlain(inputIn, EVENT_INPUT_KEYS, CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID);
   521	      if (inR.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block(inR.reasonCodes, inR.detail));
   522	      var i = inR.snapshot;
   523	
   524	      // Step 2: structural validation
   525	      if (!_idGrammarOk(i.caseId)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'caseId invalid'));
   526	      if (_arrIndexOf(EVENT_KIND_ALLOWED, i.kind) === -1) {
   527	        return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'kind not in closed enum: ' + i.kind));
   528	      }
   529	      if (!_i18nKeyOk(i.i18nKey)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'i18nKey not strict i18n key'));
   530	      // Codex E4-R1-01/03 closure: delegate params validation to the shared E4 helper
   531	      // which applies the primitive allowlist AND the post-define value-equality re-read.
   532	      var pvR = _validateEventParams(i.params);
   533	      if (pvR.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'params: ' + pvR.code));
   534	      var rebuiltParams = pvR.value;
   535	      // Correction event: correctionOf must be an existing event id (validated grammar)
   536	      // OR null/undefined. The store layer enforces append-only — the original event is
   537	      // never modified.
   538	      if (i.correctionOf !== undefined && i.correctionOf !== null) {
   539	        if (!_idGrammarOk(i.correctionOf)) return Promise.resolve(_block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'correctionOf invalid id'));
   540	      }
   541	
   542	      // Step 3: opts + clock (post-authority)
   543	      var ck = _resolveClock(optsIn);
   544	      if (ck.valid !== true) return Promise.resolve(_block(ck.reasonCodes, ck.detail));
   545	
   546	      // Step 4: fetch existing timeline to derive sequence (post-authority)
   547	      return timelineStore.getTimeline(i.caseId).then(function (existing) {
   548	        var existingEvents = (existing && _isArraySafe(existing.events)) ? existing.events : [];
   549	        var sequence = existingEvents.length;
   550	        // Codex E4-R1-05 closure: STRICT monotonicity. The E1 contract spec is monotonic
   551	        // by createdAt; equal-timestamp appends are ambiguous (the deterministic eventId
   552	        // is derived from sequence which IS unique, but two events at the same ms can
   553	        // still mask the ordering on reload). Reject refMs <= prev so every event is
   554	        // strictly later than the previous.
   555	        if (existingEvents.length > 0) {
   556	          var prevMs = _isoToMs(existingEvents[existingEvents.length - 1].createdAt);
   557	          if (prevMs !== null && ck.refMs <= prevMs) {
   558	            return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_ORDERING_INVALID], 'clock not strictly monotonic: refMs ' + ck.refMs + ' <= prev ' + prevMs);
   559	          }
   560	        }
   561	
   562	        // Codex E4-R1-04 closure: correctionOf MUST reference an existing event id in
   563	        // THIS case's timeline. Otherwise a caller could correct a non-existent event,
   564	        // leaving an orphaned reference in the persisted timeline.
   565	        if (i.correctionOf !== undefined && i.correctionOf !== null) {
   566	          var found = false;
   567	          for (var ei = 0; ei < existingEvents.length; ei++) {
   568	            if (existingEvents[ei].eventId === i.correctionOf) { found = true; break; }
   569	          }
   570	          if (!found) {
   571	            return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'correctionOf references non-existent event: ' + i.correctionOf);
   572	          }
   573	        }
   574	
   575	        // Step 5: compose event
   576	        var eventIdStr = _eventId(i.caseId, sequence, i.kind, i.i18nKey);
   577	        if (_utf8Bytes(eventIdStr) > EVENT_ID_BYTE_CAP) {
   578	          return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID, CODES.BYTE_CAP_EXCEEDED], 'eventId byte cap exceeded');
   579	        }
   580	        // If params include a correctionOf reference, store it in params under canonical key.
   581	        var finalParams = rebuiltParams;
   582	        if (i.correctionOf !== undefined && i.correctionOf !== null) {
   583	          if (finalParams === null) finalParams = {};
   584	          try {
   585	            _CAPTURED_OBJECT_DEFINE_PROPERTY(finalParams, 'correction_of', { value: i.correctionOf, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true });
   586	          } catch (e) {
   587	            return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'correctionOf injection failed');
   588	          }
   589	          // Codex E4-R1-03 closure: post-define value-equality re-read for correction_of.
   590	          var dCO;
   591	          try { dCO = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(finalParams, 'correction_of'); }
   592	          catch (eRR) { return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], 'correction_of re-read fail'); }
   593	          if (!dCO || dCO.enumerable !== true || typeof dCO.get === 'function' || typeof dCO.set === 'function') {
   594	            return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], 'correction_of post-define corrupt');
   595	          }
   596	          var coSame = false;
   597	          try { coSame = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_IS(dCO.value, i.correctionOf) === true; } catch (eRR2) { coSame = false; }
   598	          if (!coSame) {
   599	            return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], 'correction_of post-define value mismatch');
   600	          }
   601	        }
   602	        var event = {
   603	          eventId: eventIdStr,
   604	          kind: i.kind,
   605	          createdAt: ck.iso,
   606	          i18nKey: i.i18nKey,
   607	          params: finalParams,
   608	        };
   609	
   610	        // Step 6: persist via E2 store (E2 enforces duplicate + out-of-order + future-schema)
   611	        return timelineStore.appendEvent(i.caseId, event).then(function () {
   612	          _deepFreeze(event);
   613	          // Return the event envelope (NOT registered in a WeakSet here — projection is the
   614	          // authoritative aggregate; individual events live inside projections).
   615	          return _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE({ valid: true, event: event });
   616	        }, function (err) {
   617	          var code = (err && err.code) ? String(err.code) : 'append failure';
   618	          // Map store error codes to E1 reason codes for callers.
   619	          if (code === 'R3_0E_TIMELINE_DUPLICATE_EVENT') return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_INVALID], 'duplicate eventId');
   620	          if (code === 'R3_0E_TIMELINE_OUT_OF_ORDER') return _block([CODES.TIMELINE_ORDERING_INVALID], 'out-of-order timestamp');

   356	        });
